unit_interpretation: Application-context scale identifier,not SI pressure,percent or a new physical unit.

central_domain.scope: Scalar or every source-reported interval endpoint;not a reliability/compliance assertion or universal material bound.

uncertainty_domain: Absolute SD/plus-minus uses shore_a_scale points and remains nonnegative;no percent conversion or inferred confidence interval. Relative reported statistics remain separately typed.
schema_plan: Exclude shore_a_scale from all other central units;keep percent_elongation only for two elongation quantities.
ShoreA branch forbids specified_elongation and other tensile targets.
Semantic Decimal validation enforces0..100 inclusive for central scalar/interval endpoints;schema structure alone not sufficient.
Keep legacy positive-value requirements and existing zero/>100 elongation semantics.

state_plan.identity: reuse existing qualified NR identity andgrade only
state_plan.name_scope: Source-reported nominal3mm hardness specimen;no certified preparation route or stacking inferred.
state_plan.old_state_handling: Do not change1mm state/product form or attach hardness there.
state_plan.unknowns: Specific3mm preparation/cure route,thickness reconciliation,conditioning/RH,indentation face/axis,calibration andindependent batches.

required_gates: Freeze/review exact code/schema/localization/docs/new tests before native admission.
Independently review final identity/state/geometry mapping;source approval alone does not approve newstate.
Meaningful tests:0/100 boundaries,-negative/>100 reject,scalar/interval endpoints,wrongShoreD/pressure/percent/elongation units andtargets reject,oldpositivity/relative statistics preserved.
